notes.title: Mahjong Soul Steam Version FAQs
notes.notes:
[h1]Thank you for playing Mahjong Soul on Steam![/h1]

[h2][b]Version Differences & Payment Methods[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45073129/72b1b33068c2469c061359b5416b06ccea1153ed.png[/img]

[h2][b]Common Questions[/b][/h2]
[b]1. Q: Can I play with my Mahjong Soul account from other platforms (iOS/Android/Browser/Windows Client) on the Steam version of Mahjong Soul?[/b]
A: Yes, you can play with your game account from other platforms on the Steam version of Mahjong Soul. Account data (such as rank, characters, skins, etc.) and progress will be synchronized.

 [b]2. Q: What login methods are supported for the Steam version of Mahjong Soul?[/b]
A: The Steam version of Mahjong Soul currently supports logging in with Yostar (email), Facebook, Apple ID and Google accounts. 
If you use a Yostar (email), Facebook, Apple ID or Google account for login, please click on the corresponding icon on the login screen to log in.
* if you use X (Twitter) for login, you can open the Mahjong Soul game on your device and go to Settings > Others > Account Settings to link an email. Then, use that email to log into Mahjong Soul on Steam.

[b]3. Does the Steam version of Mahjong Soul support macOS?[/b]
A: Mahjong Soul does not currently support Mac OS. Mac users can play Mahjong Soul via the Browser version.

[b]4. Q: Can I use Jade and Outfit Vouchers obtained on other platforms (iOS/Android/Browser/Windows Client) in the Steam version of Mahjong Soul?
[/b]A: The Steam version shares paid Jade/Outfit Vouchers with the Browser and Windows Client version, but not with Android or iOS. However, free Jade/Outfit Vouchers are shared across all platforms.

[b]5. Q: Can players on the Steam version of Mahjong Soul play together with players from other platforms (iOS/Android/Browser/Windows Client)?[/b]
A: Yes, they can all play together.

[b]6. Q: I'm a beginner at Riichi Mahjong / I want to introduce Mahjong Soul to my friends. Where can I learn how to play Riichi Mahjong? [/b]
A: You can check in-game guide by clicking the "?" icon on the main screen. Or check the official guide [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2739990/guides/]"Mahjong Soul Classroom" [/url]on the Guides page at Steam

For more questions, please contact us: mjs.cs@yo-star.com
